domains_probe_ready: Resolves to {addresses}; certificate issued, HTTPS is serving
domains_probe_issuing: Resolves to {addresses}; Caddy is requesting a certificate — it retries automatically, usually done within a minute
domains_probe_waiting_dns: No DNS record yet — add an A record as instructed in the bind dialog; propagation usually takes a few minutes
domains_probe_dns_mismatch: Resolves to {addresses}, but this machine is {publicIp} — change the A record's value to this machine's IP at your DNS provider
domains_probe_dns_error: The resolver query failed (timeout or upstream outage); it retries automatically on the next probe
domains_unmanaged_title: This daemon does not manage the reverse proxy
domains_unmanaged_description: DORMICE_INGRESS_FILE is not configured, so binding from the web is unavailable. Re-running install.sh sets up Caddy and enables this page; or keep maintaining your own proxy configuration.
domains_empty_description: After binding, HTTPS certificates are requested and renewed automatically; whether binding succeeds or fails, IP access is always kept — you will never be locked out.
domains_probe_footnote: These probes run on the server itself and cannot prove public reachability: if the browser cannot open the HTTPS address, the cloud security group usually has not opened port 443 yet; datacenters in mainland China also require the domain to have an ICP filing, otherwise the cloud provider blocks it at the edge (unrelated to this machine's configuration).
domains_bind_description: HTTPS certificates are requested and renewed automatically, no manual setup needed; whether binding succeeds or fails, IP access is always kept — you will never be locked out.
domains_bind_step1: Step 1: add a DNS record for this domain at your DNS provider (propagation usually takes a few minutes; binding first is fine too — the page will wait for it to turn green):
domains_copy_failed: Copy failed — select the text manually
domains_record_host_hint: For the host (name) field use the subdomain prefix, or @ when binding the apex domain itself.
domains_field_domain_hint: Bare hostname, without the http:// prefix or a port.
domains_sandbox_card_desc: The wildcard domain behind port previews: with it set, every sandbox port gets its own URL, and frozen sandboxes wake on traffic. Lives in the ledger; changes apply immediately, no restart.
domains_sandbox_not_set: Not set — port previews and E2B getHost() are unavailable.
domains_sandbox_dialog_desc: Preview URLs look like <port>-<sandboxId>.<domain> and reach the sandbox port over HTTP through the :80 reverse proxy. A wildcard HTTPS certificate is your reverse proxy's business and is not managed on this page.
domains_sandbox_record_intro: Add a wildcard DNS record at your DNS provider (propagation usually takes a few minutes):
domains_sandbox_record_hint: When entering the host at your DNS provider, drop your zone's own suffix and keep the * wildcard.
domains_sandbox_saved: Sandbox domain set to {domain}, effective immediately
